part.title: SYN and SYN‑ACK exchange
part.script: Before any data can be sent, the client initiates a connection by sending a segment with the SYN flag and its initial sequence number x. The server replies with a segment that has both SYN and ACK flags set, acknowledging the client’s sequence (x+1) and providing its own initial sequence y.
visual_plan: Draw title, client and server boxes

scenes.narration: Before any data can be sent, the client initiates a connection by sending a segment with the SYN flag and its initial sequence number x.
The server replies with a segment that has both SYN and ACK flags set, acknowledging the client’s sequence (x+1) and providing its own initial sequence y.

quick_check.question: What additional information does the SYN‑ACK segment carry that the initial SYN does not?
options: Both SYN flag and acknowledgement number
quick_check.explanation: The SYN‑ACK includes the SYN flag plus the acknowledgement number (x+1) confirming the client’s SYN.
